changes.source: Army Warranting Program Policy v12 (Mar 2026), summary of changes and para 4.2: the warrant must be equal to or greater than the cumulative value of the contract including the modification (base, options, ceilings, plus the absolute value of the modification).

changes.before: Defends the decision. In a protest, GAO and the Court of Federal Claims give the record made at the time far more weight than explanations written afterward, and in a claim the Government's case is built from the file.
changes.after: Defends the decision. In a protest, GAO gives little weight to new analyses prepared in the heat of the protest and credits later explanations only when they fit the record made at the time; in a claim, the Government's case is built from the file.
changes.source: GAO bid protest decisions on gao.gov applying Boeing Sikorsky Aircraft Support, B-277263.2, B-277263.3, Sept. 29, 1997 (little weight to reevaluations prepared in the heat of the adversarial process; post-protest explanations considered when credible and consistent with the contemporaneous record). The Court of Federal Claims point had no primary source and was removed.
